title: Load Balancing Modes
summary: The mode list shown by Set Balancing Mode. The choice is stored locally and used the next time you apply the balancer.

items.title: Round-Robin (distribute equally)
items.description: Sends new connections to each node in turn.
items.usage_tip: Good for spreading traffic evenly across similar nodes.

items.title: Least Ping (prefer lowest latency)
items.description: Prefers the node with the lowest measured latency.
items.usage_tip: Run the health checker first so the latency values are fresh.

items.title: Failover (use next only if previous fails)
items.description: Keeps the first node in use and switches only when it stops responding.
items.usage_tip: Most predictable option for daily use.

items.title: Random
items.description: Picks a random node for each new connection.
items.usage_tip: Helpful for avoiding per-IP rate limits on subscription nodes.
